liquidbounce.module.parkour.description: Automatically jumps at the very edge of a block.

liquidbounce.module.phase.description: Allows you to phase through blocks by exploiting the anti-cheat.
liquidbounce.module.pingSpoof.descriptio: Spoofs your ping to a specified value.

liquidbounce.module.plugins.description: Attempts to list all plugins installed on the server.
liquidbounce.module.portalMenu.descripti: Allows you to open menus while standing inside a portal.
liquidbounce.module.potionFX.description: Renders visual aura effects around players, splash, and lingering potions.
liquidbounce.module.potionSpoof.descript: Allows the player to have potion effects without actually having the potion.
liquidbounce.module.projectileAimbot.des: Automatically aims at targets using projectile weapons like bows.
liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.de: Shoots back incoming projectiles around you.
liquidbounce.module.protectionZones.desc: Allows you to see areas protected by protection blocks and suggests optimal placement spots.
liquidbounce.module.quickPerspectiveSwap: Allows you to quickly change the game's perspective.
liquidbounce.module.radar.description: Shows the direction of rendered entities on GUI.
liquidbounce.module.replenish.descriptio: Automatically refills your hotbar with items from your inventory when the count drops to a certain threshold.
liquidbounce.module.reportHelper.descrip: Automatically starts a report and confirms it for you.
liquidbounce.module.resetVL.description: Resets anticheat violations on flawed anti-cheats.
liquidbounce.module.resourceSpoof.descri: Makes it seem like you accepted a resource pack to the server.
liquidbounce.module.reverseStep.descript: Makes you step down blocks faster.
liquidbounce.module.richPresence.descrip: Displays information about the client in your Discord rich presence.
liquidbounce.module.rotations.descriptio: Allows you to see server-sided rotations.
liquidbounce.module.safeWalk.description: Prevents you from falling down block (as if you were sneaking).
liquidbounce.module.scaffold.description: Automatically places blocks beneath your feet allowing you to walk across gaps.
liquidbounce.module.scaffold.messages.hy: This tower only works only when standing still.

liquidbounce.module.skinDerp.description: Makes the different layers of your skin turn on and off.
liquidbounce.module.sleepWalker.descript: Allows you to walk while sleeping and decreases the size of your hit box.
liquidbounce.module.smartEat.description: Automatically eats food when your hunger is low.
liquidbounce.module.snapTap.description: Prioritize the last pressed movement key.
liquidbounce.module.spammer.description: Spams the chat with specified messages.
liquidbounce.module.spearKill.descriptio: Automatically attacks enemies using a charged spear.
liquidbounce.module.spider.description: Allows you to climb walls like spiderman.
liquidbounce.module.step.description: Allows you to step up blocks faster.
liquidbounce.module.storageESP.descripti: Highlights all blocks that can contain items allowing you to see them rough walls.
liquidbounce.module.strafe.description: Allows you to strafe while being in mid-air.
liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.des: Tracks Eye of Ender throws and predicts the strongest stronghold chunk candidate.
liquidbounce.module.superKnockback.descr: Increases knockback dealt to other entities.
liquidbounce.module.surround.description: Builds holes that protect you from explosion damage.
liquidbounce.module.swingFix.description: Fixes swing packet order for 1.8 servers in-case their anti-cheat is outdated.
liquidbounce.module.swordBlock.descripti: Enables 1.8 sword blocking on servers using ViaVersion
liquidbounce.module.targetLock.descripti: Makes you attack only one specific enemy.
No longer locked on %s because they are out of range.
No longer locked on %s because the time is up.
liquidbounce.module.targetStrafe.descrip: Automatically strafes around enemies targeted by KillAura.
liquidbounce.module.targets.description: Allows you to manage which entities are considered to be your targets.

liquidbounce.module.tickBase.description: Buffer ticks to get early hits on an enemy.

liquidbounce.module.tpAura.description: Automatically teleports and attacks enemies around you.

liquidbounce.module.trajectories.descrip: Allows you to see where projectiles will land.
